verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a v2 API endpoint for registering webhooks on event types. The webhook posts to a `subscriberUrl` with a configurable payload template, and its triggers include BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED and BOOKING_CANCELLED, covering all three events in the story. Missing for 10: documentation of delivery semantics (real-time timing, retries, signature verification), evidence of user- or org-level webhooks beyond event-type scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
